yourls.title: Import from YOURLS
yourls.description: Bring your links and their full click history from a YOURLS backup file. Nothing is lost: every link keeps its ending, destination, title, creation date and click count.
yourls.fileHint: Choose the .sql file (or .sql.gz) exported from your YOURLS database. It is read in your browser and sent to hop in small parts, so large files are fine.
yourls.noLinks: We couldn't find any YOURLS links in this file. Make sure it is a backup of your YOURLS database.

summary.title: What is in the file
summary.orphansHint: They belong to short links that are not in the file, so they will not be imported.
summary.lifetimeHint: The running total kept by YOURLS. It can differ a little from the clicks listed in the history.

options.title: How to import
options.domainHint: The imported links will work on this domain.
options.noDomains: Add a short domain first (in Domains), then come back here.
options.redirectHint: 302 sends every visit through hop, so all clicks are counted. It matches what your YOURLS was doing.
options.timeZoneHint: YOURLS saves dates in UTC, so leave this as is unless you know your server saved local time. If imported dates look a few hours off, try your local time zone, for example Europe/Rome.
options.timeZoneInvalid: This time zone is not valid.
options.conflicts_one: {{count}} link in the file already uses the same ending on this domain.
options.conflicts_other: {{count}} links in the file already use the same ending on this domain.
options.noConflicts: No link on this domain uses the same endings.
options.skipHint: Keep what is already there. Their clicks are not imported either.
options.overwriteHint: Update them with the data from the file. Use this to finish an interrupted import: clicks that were already imported are never duplicated.

progress.title: Importing…
progress.keepOpen: Keep this page open until it finishes.

report.title: Import finished
report.check: On {{host}} there are now {{links}} links, with {{clicks}} clicks counted and {{history}} clicks in the history.
report.problems: These links could not be imported:

reasons.invalid_slug: the ending contains characters that are not allowed
reasons.invalid_url: the destination is not a valid web address

backup.title: Backup and export
backup.description: Download everything hop knows: links, clicks, users and their sign-in methods, tags, folders, settings and the activity log. Keep the file somewhere safe: it contains private data, such as sign-in details.
backup.csvHint: A spreadsheet with one row per link.

restore.title: Restore a backup
restore.description: A backup can only be restored into a new, empty installation. Before creating the first account, open the first-run page and choose “Restore from a backup”.

page.title: Restore from a backup
page.description: Choose a backup file downloaded from hop. Everything in it will be restored, including accounts and passwords.
page.doneText: Your links, clicks and accounts are back. Sign in with your usual account.
page.notEmpty: This installation already has accounts, so a backup can't be restored here. Restoring only works on a new, empty installation.
page.invalidFile: This doesn't look like a hop backup.

health.title: Broken link check
health.description: hop regularly visits the destination of each link. A link is marked as broken after two failed checks in a row, so a short outage doesn't raise a false alarm.
health.enabledHint: Visits each active link now and then to see if the page still works.
health.dashboardEmpty: No broken links. Everything we checked works.
health.failing: Failed once, will be checked again
